face.description: The Bosch display's glass, behind every box and in every zone (#203).

ground.description: Inside an outlined box: the glass itself, which hides the shadow under the box so that only its offset shows.

ink.description: Every label and value in an outlined box, the gear and the speed.

tileInk.description: The text on a filled box: the setting tiles, the lit pills and the alarm boxes.

edge.description: The 2 px border of an outlined box, and the ARB tile.

shadow.description: The shadow every box casts down and to the right, a solid offset of the glass, as WPF draws no blur.

green.description: The first lights of each side, and the time difference when gaining.

yellow.description: The third light of each side.

red.description: The speed over the pit limit, and the time difference when losing.

magenta.description: The lights with the pit limiter on.

tc.description: The TC tile, and a change notification's tile.

map.description: The MAP tile, the lit PSL pill and the Pit Time box.

lit.description: A lit pill, and a tyre's cell.

litEdge.description: The top edge of a tyre's cell.

pillDim.description: An unlit pill, and the temperatures' cells.

head.description: The header strip of the temperatures' cells.

alarm.description: The FUEL box under the alarm, and the Pit Time box over the limit.

data.note: The Bosch display sets its figures in a plain sans at normal width, so the numerals are Barlow like the labels, in Medium (#203).

digit.note: Barlow Medium: the widest digit is the 4 at 0.570 em and the O of OFF is 0.622, which the cell holds as the house cell holds the condensed O.

special.note: Barlow Medium: the colon is 0.348 em.

digit.note: The same face as semiBold, since this theme draws both data weights in Medium.

gear.note: Barlow Medium: the N is 0.673 em.
